parameters.subject: Thank You for Your Interest in AI Automation
parameters.message:
=Hi {{ $json["Full Name"] }}, 
Thank you for reaching out and sharing your project details. We've received your submission and our AI has completed an initial review. Your project shows good potential, and we'd like to learn more about your requirements before recommending the best solution. Our team will review your information and get back to you as soon as possible. In the meantime, if you have additional details, questions, or updates about your project, simply reply to this email. 
Thank you for considering us for your AI automation journey. 
Best regards, 
AI Automation Team

parameters.subject: Your AI Automation Project Looks Like a Great Fit!
parameters.message:
=Hi {{ $json.Name }}, 
Thank you for submitting your project details. After reviewing your requirements, our AI identified your project as a high-priority opportunity. Based on your budget, timeline, and project goals, we believe we can deliver significant value to your business. Our team would love to discuss your project in more detail and explore the best AI automation solution for your needs.

What happens next?
1. A project specialist will review your requirements.
2. We'll contact you within 24 hours.
3. You'll receive a free consultation and project roadmap.

If you'd like to get started sooner, simply reply to this email. We look forward to working with you! 
Best regards, 
AI Automation Team

parameters.message:

AI Automation Team
